design_description: A refined heritage-inspired design that pairs a warm ivory base with subtle tonal wave textures for an elegant, understated look. Burgundy trim on the collar, sleeve cuffs, and shoulder stripes provides a classic contrast, while gold accents reinforce the premium aesthetic. The minimalist composition keeps the focus on the crest, Italian shield, and central sponsor, creating a clean and balanced presentation. The soft flowing background pattern adds depth and movement without distracting from the overall simplicity of the design. Overall, the jersey feels timeless, sophisticated, and luxurious, blending classic football styling with refined Italian-inspired details.
